citations.assessment: Exact Yerushalmi Demai has Rabbi Taifa Sumaka transmitting in Rabbi Abbahu’s name. The current Heilprin heading uses Taifi. The color epithet is secure.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The opening of Jerusalem Yevamot 8 names Rabbi Tiopa Sumaka asking Rabbi Yosi. The two distinct passages differ in the surface name.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: Checked Demai and Yevamot at exact locations and retain the different surface forms. The Abbahu transmission and Yosi question are separate.
